description: This is a Java source file defining a helper class 'Log' for logging purposes within an Android project. It provides static methods for different log levels and manages a LogNode for chaining log outputs.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class providing static logging methods to facilitate log message handling and chaining within an Android application.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the logging chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Sends log data to the current LogNode with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level with optional Throwable.
